name: aa-agentic-workflow
description: Spec-driven, governance-first SDLC pipeline: optional EARS requirements → Architect (design → decompose into task-specs only if needed) → gates → Builder → Reviewer, with spec-as-source-of-truth, R# traceability, and enforced approval gates. Delegates TDD/debugging to Superpowers and quality review to built-in /code-review.
